sources.all: MEASURED by task C2b (34m88i6i8CQeU4dSuw7HM) on 2026-10-31, on GCE c2d-standard-56 (AMD EPYC 7B13, 56 vCPU): main 736f80245, 4 apiservers, 8 database cores, one link gateway node, as its comment 'C2b evidence 23' (34pav7N9HNp3sKsZc9r4j) lists them. What cell-spec.mjs prints from them is a PROJECTION: evidence 23's projection A, 6 apiservers and 11 database cores. Task O3's inputs, measured on HPC, are this file at bf061ef45.
sources.fullReconcileShare: Measured: 11.4% of the beats of hb and full-1h were reconciled in full, with -volatile (the reports that move in production moving at their production rates). It only labels the beat: both beat rows hold the mixed beat at that share. O3's estimate for production, 25%, is not in this projection.
sources.beatUnflagged, beatFull: The mixed beat in both rows, as evidence 10 had it: C2b did not run the split by kind (--mark-every). hb against full-1h: loadgen-baseline.mjs runs/hb runs/full-1h --target-events 2000 (evidence 17, 34pY4C4SzwzzqqEh5Xgc5; evidence 23).
sources.event: The same command: full-1h's 2,000 events/s, 1.55 events a batch, 64 batches a merged call (evidence 17, evidence 23).
sources.liveDelta: live-1h (--watch 500, -live-rate 10000) less full-1h, per delta the watchers received: loadgen-baseline.mjs runs/hb runs/full-1h --live runs/live-1h (evidence 23). An upper bound: the watchers' streams themselves (pings, the durable events beside the deltas) count in it. Over 6 apiservers, live-1h-r2 less full-1h-r2, the apiservers' share was 0.0999 ms (evidence 29, 34peyxbDEZJh4PDL58LEc).
sources.connect: hb's ramp, loadgen-connects.mjs (evidence 23): a link token minted, TLS, Hello, Welcome and the first beat reconciled in full.
sources.idlePerProcess: The idle stack over 60 s (evidence 23): the apiservers 0.022, 0.020, 0.048 and 0.020 cores, 0.0275 on average; the database 0.030 cores with the 4 apiservers, 0.0075 for each.
sources.gatewayBytesPerConnection: hb: the link gateway's 2,288 MiB at 15,000 connections (evidence 23).
sources.rules: O3's, but for sessionStreamsSpread: the session streams and link tokens are spread over every apiserver (34nb3xgCijTDzQJVXDVT7), as on C2b's stack (ORBIT_LINK_STAGING_SPREAD=1). Evidence 23's projection A.
